origin.volunteera.none.desc: No origin chosen. Open the origins menu to begin your path.
origin.volunteera.emberborn.desc: Born of forge-fire and fury. Your body burns hot, but water and carelessness will snuff you out.
origin.volunteera.emberborn.lore: Fire is not your weapon. It is your blood.
origin.volunteera.skyborne.desc: Child of the open sky. Winds carry you where roads cannot, but the earth pulls you down and food burns fast in your blood.
origin.volunteera.skyborne.lore: The horizon is a promise, not a border.
origin.volunteera.deepforge.desc: Carved from bedrock by elder hands. Small, stubborn, and unmatched with a pick - but the wide sky is not your friend.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_radiance.de: Ignite an inner glow: bright vision, a ring of light and hostile mobs refuse to spawn nearby. Drains food over time. Toggled with its key, ended early by sneaking.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_burning_gri: Your strikes sear: melee hits ignite enemies for a few seconds. Stronger at higher levels.
Erupt forward in a burst of flame. Nothing burns while you dash, but hunger is the price of speed.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_cinder_nova: Slam the ground to release a shockwave of heat that damages and hurls nearby enemies back. Costs food and a little of yourself.
Wrap yourself in flame: attackers burn and nearby foes slowly cook. You lose food steadily while it burns. Toggled.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_magma_blood: Your blood runs with molten rock: permanent resistance to fire and lava cannot slow you much.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_kindled_mea: Raw meat is nothing to you - you cook it with a touch. Cooked meals also restore a little extra saturation.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_blazing_lea: A rocketing jump that carries you over walls and leaves no fall damage behind. Costs food.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_pyre_ball.d: Hurl a roaring sphere of fire that explodes on impact, blazing everything nearby. Obtained through the Trial of the Pyre.
ability.volunteera.emberborn_burnout_cur: Water is your enemy: you take burning damage in rain and swim poorly. Doused in water, your flame abilities gutter and cost more for a while.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_tailwind.des: Your stride rides the wind: permanent extra ground speed that grows in open, sky-lit places.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_ascension.de: Spread wings of wind and fly freely - no rockets needed. Your flight energy is limited: land to recharge. Drains quickly, regenerates slowly.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_gale_burst.d: Release a stored burst of wind behind you. The charge refills only while you stand on the ground.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_thermal_curr: Above warm blocks - magma, fire, sand - your flight energy barely drains. Read the land and never land.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_glide.desc: Fall like a leaf: hold jump mid-air to slow your descent. Costs a trickle of food.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_tempest_dive: From high above, fold your wings and strike like lightning: a plunging attack that shatters the ground around you. Learned through the Trial of the Tempest.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_sky_marksman: Arrows loosed while airborne fly truer and hit harder.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_skyborne_res: Your body is built for the sky, not the table: you burn food faster, but carry a small reserve of meals and gain extra nutrition when eating while airborne.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_grounding_ba: Your wings carry a curse: taking heavy damage while flying slams you from the sky. Learned through the Trial of the Tempest.
ability.volunteera.skyborne_windborne_gr: Reading the air lets you fall gracefully: reduced fall damage at level 1, and at higher levels you can spend flight energy to feather an imminent landing.
ability.volunteera.deepforge_titan_swing: A lifetime in the mines: you swing tools with terrifying efficiency. Best with a pickaxe.
You are the mountain in miniature: far more resilient, but slower on your feet.
You smell ore in the stone. Nearby hidden ores whisper to you while you mine. Costs food per pulse.
ability.volunteera.deepforge_earth_shatt: Strike the ground with a heavy tool to crack the earth in a ring: enemies stagger and take damage. Costs food and health.
Generations in the dark gave you eyes that need little light.
ability.volunteera.deepforge_anvil_fists: Your blows land like a falling hammer: bonus knockback on every hit.
ability.volunteera.deepforge_molten_core: Lava is a warm bath. You swim in it and shrug off its burns.
ability.volunteera.deepforge_gilded_trea: Deep ore calls to its own: mining valuable blocks below the deepslate line slowly enriches you with experience.
Brace like a fortress wall: for a few seconds most incoming damage slides off you, but you can barely move. Learned through the Trial of the Deep.
ability.volunteera.deepforge_stonewrough: Conjure a floating lantern of stonework light that follows you and holds back the dark and its spawn. Learned through the Trial of the Deep.
trial.volunteera.emberborn_pyre.name: Trial of the Pyre
trial.volunteera.emberborn_pyre.desc: Slay 15 blazes in their fortress to prove your flame.
trial.volunteera.skyborne_tempest.name: Trial of the Tempest
trial.volunteera.skyborne_tempest.desc: Glide 2000 meters on winds you did not make - elytra or Ascension both count.
trial.volunteera.deepforge_depths.name: Trial of the Deep
trial.volunteera.deepforge_depths.desc: Break 64 blocks of deepslate below Y=-40 with a pickaxe.
